This goes beyond a mere mention and constitutes substantive coverage under the coding rules.

3.1.rationale: The text establishes a formal multisectoral coordination mechanism (a High-Level Multisectoral Commission) to direct the national system, and defines the National System as coordinating articulated and integrated actions across the state, which meets the requirement for an institutional coordination mechanism across agencies/sectors/jurisdictions.
